title: Back with Johnnie Brown, a clarinetist who practiced from lessons on the walls
summary: He returns to Brown through 1927 and admires Brown's daily warm-up on lessons pasted around his walls.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x:
I left Little Rock and went back to Johnn Brown,
and played with Johnn Brown through '25, through '26 into
'27, and left him in '27 and went back to Little Rock. And
while playing with Johnn Brown, I found Johnn Brown to be
a great clarinetist. In his home he had pasted his instructor
all over his walsl -- around the walls, see. And he would
practice -- he would just walk around the wall and just play
this different -- you know, different lessons that he had
played, you know, years ago. And he'd warm up -- that's the way
he would warm up every day, see. A great artist.
